arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ.
transliteration: Allahumma innee a'oothu bika an ushrika bika wa anaa a'lam, wa astaghfiruka limaa laa a'lam.
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating partners with You, and I ask Your forgiveness for what I do not know.
